definitions.short: support or (by implication) ability , i.e. (direct) help , (in purpose) an undertaking , (intellectual) understanding
definitions.usage: enterprise, that which (thing as it) is, substance, (sound) wisdom, working.
definitions.full: H8454. tushiyyah תּוּשִׁיָּה noun feminine sound, efficient wisdom, abiding success (on derivation, see above; according to Fl De proposes advancement , or mental aptitude that advances: for the form, compare תּוּגָה and תַּאֲנִיָה ; Sta § 262 ), a technical term of the Wisdom Literature; — a. sound, efficient wisdom Isa 28:29 (of ׳י ) תושׁיה חגדיל עצח הפליא ; Prov 3:21 תּ ׳נְצֹר זּמְזִמָּה ; 8:14 (Wisdom speaks) ות עֵצָה ׳לִי ; 18:1 תּ ׳לכל יִתְגַּלָּ֑ע ; Job 11:6 (of ׳י : see Di), 12:6 ות עֹז ׳עִמּוֺ ; 26:3 הוֺדָ֑עתָּ ׳ות לָרֹב (|| חָכְמָה לְלֹא יָעַצְתָּ b. of the effect of sound wisdom, abiding success (for the combination of meanings, compare הִשְׂכִּיל to shew wisdom. and also to achieve success ). Job 5:12 ת ׳ידיהם תעשׂינה ולא do not achieve abiding success ; 6:13 and abiding success (|| עַזְרָתִי ) is driven from me; Prov 2:7 ת לַיִשָׁרִים ׳יִצְמֹּן ; Micah 6:9 שֹׁמך יראה ותושׁיה , i.e (si vera lectio) he that seeth (heedeth) thy name is well-advised (Ges § 155 , 2 b3; Dav:§ 29 e). — תֻּשִׁיָה Job 30:22 , see sub. שׁוא .
definitions.rootNote: or תֻּשִׁיָּה ; from an unused root probably meaning to substantiate ;
